description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions related to managing localizable meta strings within the TestLink project, including creation, serialization, deserialization, and localization of string objects with parameters.

classes.name: tlMetaStringHelper
classes.description: Helper class acting as a data container for meta string properties, including label, parameters, and control flags.

classes.name: tlMetaString
classes.description: Class representing a localizable string with support for parameters, serialization, and localization, extending tlObject.

methods.name: TLS
methods.description: Creates a tlMetaString object with a label and optional parameters, firing localization events.

methods.name: _TLS
methods.description: Creates a tlMetaString object with a label and optional parameters, but suppresses event firing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tlMetaString instance, optionally with a label and parameters.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the label and parameters for the tlMetaString object.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the tlMetaString helper object for storage or transmission.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Reconstructs a tlMetaString from its serialized form.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the localized string representation of the tlMetaString.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Translates and substitutes parameters within the string, returning the localized string.
